facts.fact: The US State Department states that the official Certificate of Death, issued by the local municipality, is computerized, assigned a registration number and authenticated by local authorities; it does not say how or where the record is entered and gives no date, so the published date (itself a proxy) is used.

systems.system: Public Registration office / Office of Civil Status
systems.country_label: Public Registration office; Office of Civil Status, Municipality of Asmara
systems.tiers: Asmara and any other municipality office in which the event was registered

note: The one fact rests on a single sentence about death certificates being computerized; nothing equivalent is said of births, which are registered at municipality offices on hospital records, baptismal certificates and notarised witness statements.
